name: kavel
description: Make and edit images with Kavel's AI photo effects inside ChatGPT: pet portraits, coloring pages, family crests, D&D maps, figurines and 100+ more, on your Kavel account.

interface.longDescription:
Kavel turns a sentence or a photo into a finished image without leaving the chat.

Ask for an effect by name or describe what you want: a royal oil portrait of your dog, a dinosaur coloring page for your kid, a family crest, a D&D battle map, a Pokemon-style trainer card. Kavel finds the matching tool among 120+ tuned recipes and runs it on your photo or your words.

- Browse every effect without an account.
- Connect your Kavel account to generate. New accounts start with free credits; free-plan images carry a small watermark and wait in a short queue.
- Attach a photo in the chat and Kavel edits it.
- Results also appear in your Kavel history at kavel.ai.

Video effects (trend dances, mecha transformations and more) open on kavel.ai.
defaultPrompt: Turn this photo of my dog into a royal oil painting
Make a dinosaur coloring page for my 6-year-old
Design a family crest for the Rivera family

positive.prompt: What can Kavel do with a photo of my cat?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching Kavel tools (for example AI Pet Portrait Generator) with what each needs and its kavel.ai link. No sign-in prompt.

positive.prompt: Use Kavel to make a dinosaur coloring page for a 6-year-old.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds dinosaur-coloring-pages and generates a black-and-white line-art coloring page, returned as an image in the chat (watermarked on a free account).

positive.prompt: Turn this photo of my dog into a royal oil painting with Kavel. (attach a dog photo)
positive.expected_behavior: Runs ai-pet-portrait-generator on the attached photo and returns the painted portrait of the same dog. If the free queue is still running, returns a task id and the result arrives through check_kavel_generation.

positive.description: Pick up a run that was still rendering
positive.prompt: Is my Kavel image ready yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the finished image for the earlier task id, or how many seconds remain in the queue.

positive.prompt: How many Kavel credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the remaining credit balance of the linked Kavel account.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.

negative.description: General question that needs no image
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Video request (videos are made on kavel.ai, not in chat)
negative.prompt: Make a video of my two cats dancing to Alors on Danse.

publication.release_notes: First release: browse 120+ Kavel image effects, generate and edit images on a linked Kavel account, check results and credit balance.
